info.title: Web of Science Keyword Co-occurrence Network 2023–2024
info.description: Derived from 288 records in wos2324.ris. Keywords occurring in at least five records were normalized using wos2324-thesaurus.txt. The RIS export combines keyword entries and contains no cited-reference list, so this map is intended for exploratory training.
